discovered_theme: Forwarded message body renders empty in Thunderbird Android
root_cause_hypothesis: Multipart MIME structure from the forwarding service isn't parsed/downloaded fully by the Android client, so only headers render.
supporting_quote: The message header appears in that Thunderbird Inbox, but the body is empty.

discovered_theme: Unclear request to change sending account on phone
root_cause_hypothesis: User likely has a default identity/account set to Outlook and doesn't know how to change the sending account.
supporting_quote: It wants to send to outlook and wanting to change it on my phone only

discovered_theme: Emails stuck in Outbox on Thunderbird Android (Yahoo SMTP)
root_cause_hypothesis: Messages were flagged permanent send failures after retry exhaustion, with only a silent notification so the user sees no error.
supporting_quote: e-mails won't send. They just remain in outbox.

discovered_theme: Importing contacts.vcf into Thunderbird for Android
root_cause_hypothesis: Android app has no own address book and relies on system contacts, which isn't documented clearly.
supporting_quote: How do i import contacts.vcf in Thunderbird in Android

discovered_theme: Delayed push notifications with unified inbox on Android
root_cause_hypothesis: Unified inbox aggregation may poll rather than use per-account IMAP IDLE push, delaying notifications.
supporting_quote: When my inboxes are unified I see notifications get delay

discovered_theme: SMTP connection rejected by spam blocklist during Android setup
root_cause_hypothesis: VPN exit IP was blocklisted by the provider; disabling VPN and rebooting router changed the public IP.
supporting_quote: Server returned p-input003.msg.pkvw.co.charter.net connection rejected see www.spamhaus.org

discovered_theme: Cannot find 'always show remote images' setting in Android app
root_cause_hypothesis: Account-level 'Reading mail' settings are hidden behind tapping the account name, which is undiscoverable.
supporting_quote: there is only General Settings and no Reading mail

discovered_theme: Unsolicited Mozilla account verification code emails
root_cause_hypothesis: Someone else is attempting to log into the user's Mozilla account, triggering repeated OTP emails.
supporting_quote: Rapid emails telling me to use this code but not what to change very frustrating

discovered_theme: All email bodies display empty in Thunderbird Android 22.0
root_cause_hypothesis: Message body cache/database corruption in TBA 22.0 where preview text is stored but body download/render fails for newly synced mail.
supporting_quote: I use thunderbird and see emails and content in preview line, but when I open the mail it is empty

discovered_theme: Incoming mail not appearing without manual sync on Android
root_cause_hypothesis: Push/IDLE connection or background sync is blocked by Android battery optimization on Samsung devices.
supporting_quote: Incoming emails are not displaying in Inbox. I have tried turning sync off and push on

discovered_theme: Email vanishes after moving it out of Hotmail spam folder on Android
root_cause_hypothesis: Server-side Hotmail forwarding rule with 'do not keep a copy' re-processed the message when it re-entered the inbox, forwarding and deleting it, rather than a Thunderbird bug.
supporting_quote: I moved it to the inbox and it disappeared!

discovered_theme: Incomplete question about Thunderbird on Android
root_cause_hypothesis: User submitted the post before writing the actual question; no technical issue identifiable.
supporting_quote: Thunderbir mail access in android phone

discovered_theme: Recipient address autocomplete missing in Thunderbird for Android
root_cause_hypothesis: Autocomplete only sources the Android contacts provider and requires the contacts permission, which was not granted; no address-collection from stored mail exists.
supporting_quote: Thunderbird mobile Android does not auto complete mail addresses in the To, Cc, or Bcc fields

discovered_theme: Endless 'Load up to 25/500 more' with empty inbox on Android (POP account)
root_cause_hypothesis: POP account configured on both devices means the desktop deletes mail from the server first, while the app still shows the 'load more' affordance with no clear empty-state messaging.
supporting_quote: 'Load 500 more' was a waste of time since there was nothing there. Why not make the message say that?

discovered_theme: Thunderbird for Android 22.0 crashes at startup on Android 12 (Koin IdleRefreshManager init failure)
root_cause_hypothesis: Dependency-injection graph fails to construct IdleRefreshManager/IMAP backend on older Android 12 custom ROMs, aborting app startup.
supporting_quote: java.lang.RuntimeException: Unable to create application app.k9mail.K9App: org.koin.core.error.InstanceCreationException

discovered_theme: Message body blanks out on open until scrolled in Android 23.0
root_cause_hypothesis: WebView rendering/layout invalidation bug in the message viewer that only repaints on scroll.
supporting_quote: Some emails opened in Thunderbird for android version 23.0 immediately blank out and only reappear when scrolled.

discovered_theme: TalkTalk IMAP connection times out on port 993
root_cause_hypothesis: Network-level block (firewall/VPN) or a TalkTalk server-side email outage preventing TCP connection, not authentication.
supporting_quote: failed to connect to mail.talktalk.net/153.92.174.230 (port 993) ... ETIMEDOUT (Connection timed out)

discovered_theme: QR-code settings import option missing on Android setup screen
root_cause_hypothesis: The import entry point is nested under 'Add an email account > Scan QR code', causing discoverability confusion, compounded by a mistyped server hostname.
supporting_quote: The instructions state that clicking on "Get Started" should bring up the option to "Import Settings" but it does not.

discovered_theme: QR-code settings import option missing on Android setup screen
root_cause_hypothesis: Import UI discoverability bug (possibly github #11275) plus manual setup failing due to wrong hostname and wrong outgoing security setting (needed StartTLS/587).
supporting_quote: Unable to resolve host " twc.mail.com ": No address associated with hostname

discovered_theme: No option to cap/auto-delete locally stored messages on Android; mail marked read on server
root_cause_hypothesis: Android app lacks rolling message-retention logic and 'mark as read when opened' default propagates read state to the server, filling the phone and altering desktop state.
supporting_quote: I quickly find I have 1000+ messages stored on my phone. This eventually slows it's performance notably.

discovered_theme: Login verification loop and fingerprint rejection (likely wrong product, Firefox Focus)
root_cause_hypothesis: User posted about a different Mozilla product; the loop likely stems from a failing biometric/verification flow outside Thunderbird for Android.
supporting_quote: the useless program takes me continuous loops to log in

discovered_theme: Older messages not downloaded despite sync/message-count settings change
root_cause_hypothesis: Per-folder sync settings may not trigger a re-fetch of historical messages, or the 'sync messages from last X months' setting isn't applied retroactively in TfA 22/23.
supporting_quote: It does not lead to the download of older Mails.

discovered_theme: Virgin Media account 'authentication failed' requires app password
root_cause_hypothesis: Provider requires an app-specific password; the account password is rejected and Thunderbird gives no guidance.
supporting_quote: I tried to put my usual Virgin Media email onto Thunderbird and get 'authentication failed'

discovered_theme: QR code scanner button does nothing when no accounts configured (23.0)
root_cause_hypothesis: Known bug #11276: QR scanner fails to launch camera when the app has zero configured accounts; fixed in 24.0b1.
supporting_quote: tapping “Scan QR code” briefly highlights the button, but nothing else happens

discovered_theme: Forwarded third-party (Duck) emails not appearing in Gmail account in app
root_cause_hypothesis: Server-side Gmail filters/labels divert forwarded mail out of the Inbox, or a POP3 desktop client removes it before sync.
supporting_quote: ones forwarded from the duck.com address to Gmail are not showing in Thunderbird

discovered_theme: Cannot find/add contacts in Thunderbird for Android
root_cause_hypothesis: Contacts permission not granted, so the 'Add from contacts' option is hidden with no explanatory UI.
supporting_quote: unable to locate add my contests on Thunderbird for Android

discovered_theme: Certificate domain mismatch and wrong server hostnames after QR import
root_cause_hypothesis: User used a generic mail host name instead of the provider's certificate-matching hostnames, triggering CN mismatch on both desktop and Android.
supporting_quote: The certificate for mail.first-rate.info is not valid for that server.

discovered_theme: Unlabeled hexagon '!' spam button icon unclear in message header
root_cause_hypothesis: Icon affordance for 'mark as spam' is not self-explanatory and lacks a visible label.
supporting_quote: I see an hex shaped icon with an "!" symbol at the top message header. What is the function?

discovered_theme: No background sync or new-mail notifications unless app opened manually
root_cause_hypothesis: Android battery optimization suspends background activity and per-folder sync is off by default.
supporting_quote: How can I get thunderbird to sync on its own and send notifications of new emails

discovered_theme: Cannot select recipients from address book when composing on Android
root_cause_hypothesis: Contacts permission not granted, so address book lookup during compose fails.
supporting_quote: The program does not agree to take names from my address list and send mail.

discovered_theme: Unified inbox sorted incorrectly instead of by date
root_cause_hypothesis: The unified inbox sort criteria had been changed away from date (user error), not an app bug.
supporting_quote: Since 1 or 2 weeks my shared inbox is sorted wrong.

discovered_theme: Marking mail as junk on Android does not block future sender mail
root_cause_hypothesis: Thunderbird for Android has no local spam filtering or rules engine; junk marking only moves the message.
supporting_quote: Lorsque je mets un courriel en indésible, lors d'un nouvel envoi je le rtrouve dans ma boite de reception.

discovered_theme: POP3 messages not deleted locally when removed from server on Android
root_cause_hypothesis: K-9/TBfA treats POP3 like IMAP; the 'Sync Server Deletions' setting governs local deletion and was disabled.
supporting_quote: I need Thunderbird on Android to start removing them again once I clear the server.

discovered_theme: Cannot create folders or contacts in Thunderbird for Android
root_cause_hypothesis: Folder creation is unimplemented in the Android app; contacts rely on the system contacts provider.
supporting_quote: How do I add folders and contacts?

discovered_theme: Sender IP exposed in Received header; no SMTP proxy support
root_cause_hypothesis: Client connects directly to SMTP so server logs the real IP; no SOCKS/HTTP proxy feature exists in the app.
supporting_quote: the receiving mail server adds a `Received` header that contains my real public IP address

discovered_theme: App crashes and missing Sent/Drafts folders and vanishing messages after POP-to-IMAP switch
root_cause_hypothesis: IMAP special-folder mapping/namespace prefix handling plus folder subscription issues cause crashes and folder/message disappearance after protocol change.
supporting_quote: the 26 emails have disappeared & Inbox.sent, Inbox.drafts have disappeared

discovered_theme: Cannot re-enable push/sync notifications once disabled in-app
root_cause_hypothesis: Notification channel toggle is only reachable from the notification itself, and Samsung hides Android notification categories by default.
supporting_quote: i accidentally turned off "Show notifications" in the syncronization thing and now i can't turn it back on

discovered_theme: Message list goes blank after reading/deleting emails
root_cause_hypothesis: UI list state/database refresh race after deletion leaves the RecyclerView empty until cache clear or restart.
supporting_quote: the email list will just go blank for a bit of time, sometimes I need to exit clear cache and reopen

discovered_theme: No option to always display remote images automatically
root_cause_hypothesis: Remote image blocking default lacks an easily discoverable always-show setting per account.
supporting_quote: 现在我必须每次都手动点击邮件中的显示图片按钮

discovered_theme: Folder list not downloading for NetZero account on Android
root_cause_hypothesis: NetZero account likely configured as POP or server LIST/namespace response not parsed, so no folders sync.
supporting_quote: I added my Netzero account to Thunderbird for Android but my folders didn't download

discovered_theme: Thunderbird Android IMAP push notifications unreliable with Outlook accounts
root_cause_hypothesis: IMAP IDLE connections to Outlook/Office365 servers are likely dropped or not resumed by the Android background service, so new-mail push events are missed while Gmail IDLE works reliably.
supporting_quote: Gmail messages are received consistently every time Outlook account messages are still sporadic....sometimes coming in sometimes not
